item.title: Cisco's falling margin shows hyperscaler AI is now big enough to reshape the business
item.summary: Cisco Systems closed fiscal 2026 with results that would normally have looked decisively positive. Revenue rose 18% to US$17.3 billion, networking orders posted double-digit growth for an eighth straight quarter, and AI infrastructure orders from hyperscalers reached 4.5 times the previous year's total. Yet the market's focus shifted to a less comfortable signal: Cisco expects non-GAAP gross margin to ease next quarter, suggesting the hyperscaler business is now large enough to move the company's overall economics.
